fact: EthSwitch presented its Unified Government Payment Platform at the Ethiopia Finance Forum, a single interoperable route through the national switch for government bill payments by app, ATM, USSD, branch and agent.

Addis Fortune reports Ethiopia has begun piloting a Unified Government Payment Platform in the health sector for citizens to pay public services, including facility payments and health insurance premiums, with about 16 institutions in the pipeline and wider rollout targeted for 2029, per UNDP project lead Desta Bayissa.

M-PESA Ethiopia launched a Tax Payment Mini App letting taxpayers in the Amhara Region pay the Amhara Bureau of Revenue by Bill ID, the first of planned integrations with regional revenue authorities.

Directive 1069/2025 requires all federal public bodies, within 90 days, to accept electronic payments of fees, charges, taxes and penalties from licensed providers and to integrate their collection systems with authorised payment gateways, with the Ministry of Finance monitoring.

Addis Fortune reports the Ministry of Revenues announced an expansion of the e-tax system so that late and advance payments, partial filing and audit findings are handled through the digital platform.
Webb Fontaine says electronic payment facilities were introduced in Ethiopia's Webb Customs eCMS, reducing manual paperwork.
